page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/adr.md` for the full workflow. Determines the architecture domain (Application, Business, Governance, Information, Infrastructure, ITSM-Operations, Security, or Technology), then checks `decisions/<domain>/` for an existing ADR matching the request. If none exists, derives a kebab-case title slug from the request, finds the next available ADR number, copies the template from `resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/architecture-decision-record.md`, and creates `decisions/<domain>/ADR-<DOMAIN>-<NNN>-<title-slug>.md` with status "Proposed". If one exists, revises it in place, preserving its ID and path, and logs the change in its Change History. Updates `decisions/<domain>/README.md` either way. Ends with a convergence pass per `.claude/skills/ai-convergence/SKILL.md`. Use the governance review process in `governance/processes/architecture-governance.md`.
